Quick Background

When you're trying to get a subverse off the ground, it's like talking to yourself. For awhile I was the only one posting things here. It wasn't daunting or anything, because I was doing it for myself. /v/Dreamworlds was a place where I could put otherworldly whimsical things I find, whether it would be 2D art, music, videos, stories, or whatever. I have collections on DeviantArt and ArtStation, and playlists on Plug.dj and Youtube, so I don't really need this place to keep track of the things I find. The purpose of this place was to share it publicly in a centralized location because I knew that there were people out there that would like to see it, I figured it was the right thing to do... that it was fair.

Now, even though we've only got ~3 regular posters, /v/Dreamworlds has turned into a place where, instead of people discovering things that one person (myself) has found, multiple people are sharing things they've found with others. At this point, the subverse is becoming what I've always intended it to be. The community is still a bit small, but I'm fine with that, and I've always been. Ideally, I'd rather the community be more active than this â€” posting to conversation threads, hanging out in the music room, posting something every now and then â€” which will happen in the future as it continues to grow, and it will. So far the only advertising that's been done for this subverse was, I believe I made a post to /v/newsubverses/ awhile back, and this place was featured for about two weeks last month. That means that this subverse has been growing almost solely off accidental discovery and word of mouth.

The Next Step

Currently, my next goal is to get the community more active. I use the term "goal" loosely because I'm fine with where the subverse is now, but I'm a bit of a perfectionist, and there's always room for improvement. I would rather have a small community of art enthusiasts that are passionate about this kind of thing than a large community of faceless internet dwellers that are only here to get some karma because the place has gotten huge.

After that, my goal would be what I brought up in a past stickied post, dreamification threads, which definitely could use a better name. I mentioned that my next goal is for the sub to accumulate more art enthusiasts; that would knock out two birds with one stone. Not only would it fulfill my goal to have a small, active community, but it would also make it easier to find a volunteer artist to assist in dreamification threads. There are plenty of good artists out there that do what they do for the fun of it and I think they'd like the idea of taking real-world locations and turning them into a dreamworld. It would also help motivate them if the community were full of other art enthusiasts to give them the appreciation they deserve for their volunteer work.

Conclusion

Above all that, I'm fine with where the subverse currently is and I wouldn't do anything to jeopardize that. If this subverse were to become huge, it would be irreversible. I mean, the masses aren't just gonna leave once they've decided they like this place. That being said, I'll continue to let this place be the high-quality, steadily growing community that it is.

Also, congratulations to @SilverBanana for being the first to earn the Veteran tag. He was the first regular poster here besides myself, so he's earned it. I've got you in my sights too, @xbryn.
